latest.title: Flows and Homotopies of Banach Lie algebroids
latest.abstract: We establish flow and homotopy tools for Banach Lie algebroids that do not rely on compactly supported extensions. Under suitable hypotheses, we construct parameter-dependent local extensions of sections along algebroid paths, complete lifts and their fibrewise-linear evolutions, and a Bochner-integral variation-of-constants formula. We then prove that an admissible-path homotopy is equivalently a Lie algebroid morphism from the parameter square and a solution of the associated transport equation. This provides the extension, transport and infinitesimal variation theory required for a local integration program of Banach Lie algebroids to be developed in a sequel.
latest.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
latest.progressType: 无限维局部流与同伦基础
latest.workSummary: 在 Banach Lie algebroid 上建立参数依赖的局部截面延拓、完全提升及纤维线性流、Bochner 积分变常公式，并证明可容许路径的同伦、参数方形上的 algebroid 态射与输运方程之间的等价性。
techniques: 完全提升及纤维线性演化
latest.breakthrough: 绕过一般 Banach 流形上缺少光滑 bump 函数和紧支延拓的问题，为无限维局部积分理论建立所需的无穷小工具。
latest.limitations: 参数统一延拓和同伦结论有联络及光滑仿紧性等条件；本文明确不构造积分的局部 Banach Lie groupoid，该工作留待后续。
latest.priorityReason: 填补无限维微分几何常用论证中的基础空缺，技术严谨性值得关注；目前定位是后续积分计划的工具层，应用范围专门。
